— atmosfera bosimida havoning qisqa mudd: — a brief breakdown of air at atmospheric pressure. When the discs of the electrostatic machine rotate, charges are separated by induction and collected in Leyden jars (capacitors). When the voltage reaches the breakdown value, a narrow, bright, winding ionized channel forms between the balls and the jars discharge instantly — a crack is heard (the air heats up and expands sharply).
